pages._text:
Sam holds Ted close.
They sit together.
Home is quiet around them.

The train starts moving.
Ted slips from the bag.
Sam reaches in and stops.

Sam stands on the platform.
He waits by the track.
Ted climbs onto the next train.

Ted rides along.
A tall green tree passes by.
Ted watches it go.

The tall green tree stays in sight.
A shiny blue river appears.
Ted keeps watching.

The tall green tree.
The shiny blue river.
A round yellow sun joins them.

Ted sees the station.
The train stops.
Sam picks him up.

Sam hugs Ted tight.
They sit together again.
Home waits for them.
